@'
import { BaseViewModel } from "base";
import { AddressRepository } from "data";
import { Address, Id, NetworkResponse } from "model";
import {
  AddressSaveOperation, getRouteParams, navigateBackWithResult,
  UserAddressDetailParam, UserAddressSaveResult
} from "navigation";
import { ValidationUtil } from "util";
import { addressError, isAddress, sameAddressFields } from "../model/AddressResponse";
import { findRegion, RegionSelection, resolveRegion } from "../model/AddressRegion";

@ObservedV2
export default class AddressDetailViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  @Trace contact: string = "";
  @Trace phone: string = "";
  @Trace province: string = "";
  @Trace city: string = "";
  @Trace district: string = "";
  @Trace address: string = "";
  @Trace isDefault: boolean = false;
  @Trace isEditMode: boolean = false;
  @Trace isLoading: boolean = false;
  @Trace isReady: boolean = false;
  @Trace isSaving: boolean = false;
  @Trace loadError: string = "";
  @Trace error: string = "";
  @Trace pickerVisible: boolean = false;
  @Trace awaitingVerification: boolean = false;
  private repository: AddressRepository;
  private originalAddress: Address | null = null;
  private regionSelection: RegionSelection = new RegionSelection();
  private addressId: number = 0;
  private knownIds: number[] = [];
  private hasCompleteSnapshot: boolean = false;
  private pendingPayload: Address | null = null;
  private disposed: boolean = false;
  private generation: number = 0;
  private hasReturned: boolean = false;

  constructor(repository: AddressRepository = new AddressRepository()) {
    super();
    this.repository = repository;
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    const params: UserAddressDetailParam | undefined = getRouteParams<UserAddressDetailParam | undefined>("user/address-detail");
    this.initialize(params);
  }

  initialize(params?: UserAddressDetailParam): void {
    this.isEditMode = params?.isEditMode === true;
    this.addressId = params?.addressId ?? 0;
    this.knownIds = params?.knownAddressIds?.slice() ?? [];
    this.hasCompleteSnapshot = params?.hasCompleteAddressSnapshot === true;
    if (this.isEditMode) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(this.addressId) || this.addressId <= 0) {
        this.loadError = "地址参数无效，请返回列表重试";
        return;
      }
      this.loadDetail();
    } else {
      this.isReady = true;
    }
  }

  async loadDetail(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.isLoading || this.isSaving || this.disposed || !this.isEditMode || this.addressId <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    const epoch: number = ++this.generation;
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.loadError = "";
    try {
      const response: NetworkResponse<Address> = await this.repository.getAddressInfo(this.addressId);
      if (!this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        return;
      }
      if (response?.code !== 1000 || !isAddress(response.data) || response.data?.id !== this.addressId) {
        this.loadError = response?.message || "地址详情加载失败，请重试";
        return;
      }
      const saved: Address = new Address(response.data);
      this.originalAddress = new Address(saved);
      this.contact = saved.contact;
      this.phone = saved.phone;
      this.province = saved.province;
      this.city = saved.city;
      this.district = saved.district;
      this.address = saved.address;
      this.isDefault = saved.isDefault;
      this.regionSelection = findRegion(saved.province, saved.city, saved.district);
      this.isReady = true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        this.loadError = addressError(error);
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        this.isLoading = false;
      }
    }
  }

  get title(): string {
    return this.isEditMode ? "编辑地址" : "新增地址";
  }

  get regionText(): string {
    return [this.province, this.city, this.district].filter((value: string): boolean => value.length > 0).join(" ");
  }

  get pickerSelection(): RegionSelection {
    return findRegion(this.province, this.city, this.district);
  }

  openRegion(): void {
    if (this.isReady && !this.isSaving && !this.awaitingVerification) {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    }
  }

  confirmRegion(selection: RegionSelection): void {
    const valid: RegionSelection | null = resolveRegion(selection.provinceCode, selection.cityCode, selection.districtCode);
    if (!valid || this.isSaving) {
      return;
    }
    this.regionSelection = valid;
    this.province = valid.province;
    this.city = valid.city;
    this.district = valid.district;
    this.pickerVisible = false;
    this.clearError();
  }

  clearError(): void {
    if (!this.awaitingVerification) {
      this.error = "";
    }
  }

  handleBack(): boolean {
    if (this.isSaving) {
      return true;
    }
    if (this.pickerVisible) {
      this.pickerVisible = false;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  validate(): boolean {
    const original: Address | null = this.originalAddress;
    if (!this.contact.trim().length) {
      this.error = "请填写联系人";
    } else if ((!this.isEditMode || this.phone !== original?.phone) && !this.phone.trim().length) {
      this.error = "请填写手机号";
    } else if ((!this.isEditMode || this.phone !== original?.phone) && !ValidationUtil.isValidPhone(this.phone)) {
      this.error = "手机号格式不正确";
    } else if (!this.regionIsUnchanged() && !resolveRegion(this.regionSelection.provinceCode, this.regionSelection.cityCode, this.regionSelection.districtCode)) {
      this.error = "请选择完整的所在地区";
    } else if (!this.address.trim().length) {
      this.error = "请填写详细地址";
    } else {
      this.error = "";
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private regionIsUnchanged(): boolean {
    const original: Address | null = this.originalAddress;
    return this.isEditMode && original !== null && this.province === original.province &&
      this.city === original.city && this.district === original.district;
  }

  private payload(): Address {
    const result: Address = this.originalAddress ? new Address(this.originalAddress) : new Address();
    result.contact = this.contact;
    result.phone = this.phone;
    result.province = this.province;
    result.city = this.city;
    result.district = this.district;
    result.address = this.address;
    result.isDefault = this.isDefault;
    return result;
  }

  async save(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isReady || this.isSaving || this.awaitingVerification || this.hasReturned || this.disposed || !this.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    const payload: Address = this.payload();
    const epoch: number = ++this.generation;
    this.pendingPayload = new Address(payload);
    this.isSaving = true;
    try {
      if (this.isEditMode) {
        const response: NetworkResponse<void> = await this.repository.updateAddress(payload);
        if (!this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
          return;
        }
        if (response?.code === 1000) {
          this.finish(payload);
        } else {
          this.error = response?.message || "保存失败，请重试";
        }
      } else {
        const response: NetworkResponse<Id> = await this.repository.addAddress(payload);
        if (!this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
          return;
        }
        if (response?.code !== 1000) {
          this.error = response?.message || "保存失败，请重试";
        } else if (response.data && Number.isInteger(response.data.id) && response.data.id > 0) {
          payload.id = response.data.id;
          this.finish(payload);
        } else {
          this.awaitingVerification = true;
          await this.verifyPending(epoch);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        // A lost response can follow a committed write. Read before another write.
        this.awaitingVerification = true;
        this.error = `${addressError(error)}；保存结果待核实，请重试同步`;
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        this.isSaving = false;
      }
    }
  }

  async retryVerification(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.awaitingVerification || this.isSaving || this.disposed || this.hasReturned) {
      return;
    }
    const epoch: number = ++this.generation;
    this.isSaving = true;
    try {
      await this.verifyPending(epoch);
    } finally {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        this.isSaving = false;
      }
    }
  }

  private async verifyPending(epoch: number): Promise<void> {
    const payload: Address | null = this.pendingPayload;
    if (!payload) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (this.isEditMode) {
        const response: NetworkResponse<Address> = await this.repository.getAddressInfo(this.addressId);
        if (!this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
          return;
        }
        if (response?.code === 1000 && isAddress(response.data) && response.data?.id === this.addressId && sameAddressFields(response.data, payload)) {
          this.finish(new Address(response.data));
          return;
        }
      } else if (this.hasCompleteSnapshot) {
        const response: NetworkResponse<Address[]> = await this.repository.getAddressList();
        if (!this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
          return;
        }
        if (response?.code === 1000 && Array.isArray(response.data)) {
          const matches: Address[] = response.data.filter((item: Address): boolean =>
            isAddress(item) && !this.knownIds.includes(item.id) && sameAddressFields(item, payload));
          if (matches.length === 1) {
            this.finish(new Address(matches[0]));
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      this.error = "保存已提交，结果待同步。请重试同步，或返回列表核实";
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isCurrent(epoch)) {
        this.error = `${addressError(error)}；保存结果待同步`;
      }
    }

## Event 230 · 2026-10-18T12:06:12.854Z · event_msg item_completed 

### Readable $.item.parsed_cmd[0].cmd

```
@'
import { BaseNetWorkListUiState } from "base";
import { Address } from "model";
import { navigateBack } from "navigation";
import { AddressActionButton, AddressCard, AppNavDestination, RefreshLayout } from "ui";
import AddressListViewModel from "../viewmodel/AddressListViewModel";

@ComponentV2
export struct AddressListPage {
  @Local private vm: AddressListViewModel = new AddressListViewModel();
  private listScroller: Scroller = new Scroller();

  build() {
    AppNavDestination({ title: "收货地址", viewModel: this.vm, onBackPressed: (): boolean => this.vm.handleBack() }) {
      Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.Center }) {
        Column({ space: 12 }) {
          Row() {
            Button("返回").id("address_list_back").onClick((): void => {
              if (!this.vm.handleBack()) {
                navigateBack();
              }
            });
            Blank();
            Text(this.vm.isSelectMode ? "选择收货地址" : "管理收货地址").fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"));
            Blank();
            Button("刷新").enabled(!this.vm.isLoading && !this.vm.isDeleting).onClick((): void => this.vm.retryRequest());
          }.width("100%");
          if (this.vm.syncError) {
            Column({ space: 6 }) {
              Text(this.vm.syncError).id("address_list_sync_error").fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"));
              Button("重试同步").id("address_list_sync_retry").enabled(!this.vm.isLoading)
                .onClick((): void => this.vm.retryRequest());
            }.width("100%");
          }
          if (this.vm.uiState === BaseNetWorkListUiState.LOADING) {
            Column({ space: 12 }) {
              LoadingProgress().width(36).height(36);
              Text("加载地址中");
            }.id("address_list_loading").layoutWeight(1).justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center);
          } else if (this.vm.uiState === BaseNetWorkListUiState.ERROR) {
            Column({ space: 12 }) {
              Text(this.vm.error).id("address_list_error");
              Button("重试").id("address_list_retry").onClick((): void => this.vm.retryRequest());
            }.layoutWeight(1).justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center);
          } else if (this.vm.uiState === BaseNetWorkListUiState.EMPTY) {
            Column({ space: 12 }) {
              Text("还没有收货地址").id("address_list_empty");
              Text("点击下方按钮新增地址").fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"));
            }.layoutWeight(1).justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center);
          } else {
            RefreshLayout({
              loading: this.vm.isLoading, isEnableSlideUp: false, scroller: this.listScroller,
              onRefresh: (direction): void => this.vm.onRefreshDirection(direction)
            }) {
              List({ space: 12, scroller: this.listScroller }) {
                ForEach(this.vm.listData, (item: Address): void => {
                  ListItem() {
                    AddressCard({
                      address: item, cardId: `address_row_${item.id}`,
                      onTap: (): void => this.vm.onAddressClick(item),
                      actionSlot: (): void => this.Actions(item)
                    });
                  }
                }, (item: Address): string => `${item.id}`);
              }.width("100%").height("100%").id("address_list");
            }.layoutWeight(1);
          }
          Button("新增地址")
            .id("address_add_button")
            .width("100%")
            .height(48)
            .enabled(!this.vm.navigationBusy && !this.vm.isDeleting && !this.vm.deleteTarget)
            .onClick((): void => this.vm.onAddAddress());
        }.width("100%").height("100%").padding(16).id("address_list_page");
        if (this.vm.deleteTarget) {
          this.DeleteDialog();
        }
      }.width("100%").height("100%");
    }
  }

  @Builder
  private Actions(item: Address): void {
    Row({ space: 10 }) {
      AddressActionButton({
        iconResId: $r("app.media.ic_edit_fill"), actionId: `address_edit_${item.id}`, actionLabel: "编辑地址",
        onTap: (): void => this.vm.onEditAddress(item.id)
      });
      AddressActionButton({
        iconResId: $r("app.media.ic_delete_fill"), actionId: `address_delete_${item.id}`, actionLabel: "删除地址",
        onTap: (): void => this.vm.onDeleteAddress(item.id)
      });
    }
  }

  @Builder
  private DeleteDialog(): void {
    Stack() {
      Column().width("100%").height("100%").backgroundColor("#66000000")
        .onClick((): void => this.vm.cancelDelete());
      Column({ space: 20 }) {
        Text("确认删除该地址吗？").fontSize(20).id("address_delete_message");
        if (this.vm.error) {
          Text(this.vm.error).fontColor(Color.Red);
        }
        if (this.vm.isDeleting) {
          LoadingProgress().width(32).height(32).id("address_delete_loading");
        }
        Row({ space: 20 }) {
          Button("取消").id("address_delete_cancel").enabled(!this.vm.isDeleting)
            .onClick((): void => this.vm.cancelDelete());
          Button(this.vm.deleteUncertain ? "重试同步" : "确认")
            .id("address_delete_confirm").enabled(!this.vm.isDeleting)
            .onClick((): void => {
              if (this.vm.deleteUncertain) {
                this.vm.verifyDelete();
              } else {
                this.vm.confirmDelete();
              }
            });
        }
      }.padding(24).width("85%").backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_white")).borderRadius(16)
        .id("address_delete_dialog");
    }.width("100%").height("100%");
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath feature/user/src/main/ets/view/AddressListPage.ets -Encoding utf8
```

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force feature/user/src/main/ets/component | Out-Null
@'
import { CascaderOption } from "@ibestservices/area-data";
import { addressRegions, RegionSelection, resolveRegion } from "../model/AddressRegion";

@ComponentV2
export struct AddressRegionPicker {
  @Param selection: RegionSelection = new RegionSelection();
  @Param onConfirm: (value: RegionSelection) => void = (): void => {};
  @Param onCancel: () => void = (): void => {};
  @Local private provinceCode: string = "";
  @Local private cityCode: string = "";
  @Local private districtCode: string = "";
  @Local private provinces: CascaderOption[] = addressRegions;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.provinceCode = this.selection.provinceCode;
    this.cityCode = this.selection.cityCode;
    this.districtCode = this.selection.districtCode;
  }

  private cities(): CascaderOption[] {
    return this.provinces.find((item: CascaderOption): boolean => item.value === this.provinceCode)?.children ?? [];
  }

  private districts(): CascaderOption[] {
    return this.cities().find((item: CascaderOption): boolean => item.value === this.cityCode)?.children ?? [];
  }

  private chooseProvince(item: CascaderOption): void {
    if (this.provinceCode !== item.value) {
      this.provinceCode = item.value;
      this.cityCode = "";
      this.districtCode = "";
    }
  }

  private chooseCity(item: CascaderOption): void {
    if (this.cityCode !== item.value) {
      this.cityCode = item.value;
      this.districtCode = "";
    }
  }

  build() {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.Bottom }) {
      Column().width("100%").height("100%").backgroundColor("#66000000").onClick((): void => this.onCancel());
      Column({ space: 12 }) {
        Text("选择所在地区").fontSize(20).fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold);
        Row() {
          Text("省").layoutWeight(1).textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
          Text("市").layoutWeight(1).textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
          Text("区").layoutWeight(1).textAlign(TextAlign.Center);
        }.width("100%");
        if (this.provinces.length > 0) {
          Row({ space: 4 }) {
            List() {
              ForEach(this.provinces, (item: CascaderOption): void => {
                ListItem() {
                  Text(item.text).width("100%").padding(12).fontSize(15)
                    .fontColor(this.provinceCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.primary") : $r("app.color.text_primary"))
                    .backgroundColor(this.provinceCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.bg_grey") : $r("app.color.bg_white"))
                    .id(`region_province_${item.value}`).onClick((): void => this.chooseProvince(item));
                }
              }, (item: CascaderOption): string => item.value);
            }.layoutWeight(1).height("100%");
            List() {
              ForEach(this.cities(), (item: CascaderOption): void => {
                ListItem() {
                  Text(item.text).width("100%").padding(12).fontSize(15)
                    .fontColor(this.cityCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.primary") : $r("app.color.text_primary"))
                    .backgroundColor(this.cityCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.bg_grey") : $r("app.color.bg_white"))
                    .id(`region_city_${item.value}`).onClick((): void => this.chooseCity(item));
                }
              }, (item: CascaderOption): string => item.value);
            }.layoutWeight(1).height("100%");
            List() {
              ForEach(this.districts(), (item: CascaderOption): void => {
                ListItem() {
                  Text(item.text).width("100%").padding(12).fontSize(15)
                    .fontColor(this.districtCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.primary") : $r("app.color.text_primary"))
                    .backgroundColor(this.districtCode === item.value ? $r("app.color.bg_grey") : $r("app.color.bg_white"))
                    .id(`region_district_${item.value}`).onClick((): void => { this.districtCode = item.value; });
                }
              }, (item: CascaderOption): string => item.value);
            }.layoutWeight(1).height("100%");
          }.width("100%").layoutWeight(1);
        } else {
          Text("地区数据加载失败").layoutWeight(1);
          Button("重试").onClick((): void => { this.provinces = addressRegions; });
        }
        Row({ space: 20 }) {
          Button("取消").id("region_cancel").layoutWeight(1).onClick((): void => this.onCancel());
          Button("确认").id("region_confirm").layoutWeight(1)
            .enabled(resolveRegion(this.provinceCode, this.cityCode, this.districtCode) !== null)
            .onClick((): void => {
              const result: RegionSelection | null = resolveRegion(this.provinceCode, this.cityCode, this.districtCode);
              if (result) {
                this.onConfirm(result);
              }
            });
        }.width("100%");
      }.width("100%").height("75%").padding(16).backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_white"))
        .borderRadius({ topLeft: 16, topRight: 16 }).id("address_region_picker");
    }.width("100%").height("100%");
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath feature/user/src/main/ets/component/AddressRegionPicker.ets -Encoding utf8
@'
import { navigateBack } from "navigation";
import { AppNavDestination } from "ui";
import { AddressRegionPicker } from "../component/AddressRegionPicker";
import { RegionSelection } from "../model/AddressRegion";
import AddressDetailViewModel from "../viewmodel/AddressDetailViewModel";

@ComponentV2
export struct AddressDetailPage {
  @Local private vm: AddressDetailViewModel = new AddressDetailViewModel();

  build() {
    AppNavDestination({ title: this.vm.title, viewModel: this.vm, onBackPressed: (): boolean => this.vm.handleBack() }) {
      Stack() {
        Column({ space: 16 }) {
          Row() {
            Button("返回").id("address_form_back").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving).onClick((): void => {
              if (!this.vm.handleBack()) {
                navigateBack();
              }
            });
            Text(this.vm.title).fontSize(22).fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold).layoutWeight(1)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center).id("address_form_title");
            Blank().width(64);
          }.width("100%");
          if (this.vm.isLoading) {
            Column({ space: 12 }) {
              LoadingProgress().width(36).height(36);
              Text("加载地址中");
            }.layoutWeight(1).justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center).id("address_detail_loading");
          } else if (!this.vm.isReady) {
            Column({ space: 12 }) {
              Text(this.vm.loadError).id("address_detail_error");
              Button("重试").id("address_detail_retry").onClick((): void => { this.vm.loadDetail(); });
            }.layoutWeight(1).justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center);
          } else {
            Scroll() {
              Column({ space: 16 }) {
                this.Label("联系人");
                TextInput({ text: this.vm.contact, placeholder: "请填写联系人" })
                  .id("address_contact_input").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
                  .onChange((value: string): void => { this.vm.contact = value; this.vm.clearError(); });
                this.Label("手机号");
                TextInput({ text: this.vm.phone, placeholder: "请填写手机号" }).type(InputType.PhoneNumber)
                  .id("address_phone_input").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
                  .onChange((value: string): void => { this.vm.phone = value; this.vm.clearError(); });
                this.Label("所在地区");
                Button(this.vm.regionText || "请选择所在地区", { type: ButtonType.Normal })
                  .width("100%").height(48).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_primary"))
                  .backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_grey")).borderRadius(12)
                  .id("address_region_input").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
                  .onClick((): void => this.vm.openRegion());
                this.Label("详细地址");
                TextArea({ text: this.vm.address, placeholder: "街道、楼牌号等" }).height(100)
                  .id("address_detail_input").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
                  .onChange((value: string): void => { this.vm.address = value; this.vm.clearError(); });
                Row() {
                  Text("设为默认地址").fontSize(16).layoutWeight(1);
                  Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.vm.isDefault })
                    .id("address_default_switch").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
                    .onChange((value: boolean): void => { this.vm.isDefault = value; this.vm.clearError(); });
                }.width("100%");
              }.width("100%").alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start).padding(16)
                .backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_white")).borderRadius(12).id("address_form_ready");
            }.width("100%").layoutWeight(1);
            if (this.vm.error) {
              Text(this.vm.error).width("100%").fontColor(Color.Red).id("address_form_error");
            }
            if (this.vm.isSaving) {
              LoadingProgress().width(30).height(30).id("address_save_loading");
            }
            if (this.vm.awaitingVerification) {
              Button("重试同步").width("100%").enabled(!this.vm.isSaving)
                .id("address_verify_retry").onClick((): void => { this.vm.retryVerification(); });
            }
            Button(this.vm.isEditMode ? "保存" : "保存地址")
              .id("address_save_button").width("100%").height(48)
              .enabled(!this.vm.isSaving && !this.vm.awaitingVerification)
              .onClick((): void => { this.vm.save(); });
          }
        }.width("100%").height("100%").padding(16).id("address_form_page");
        if (this.vm.pickerVisible) {
          AddressRegionPicker({
            selection: this.vm.pickerSelection,
            onConfirm: (value: RegionSelection): void => this.vm.confirmRegion(value),
            onCancel: (): void => { this.vm.pickerVisible = false; }
          });
        }
      }.width("100%").height("100%");
    }
  }

  @Builder
  private Label(value: string): void {
    Text(`${value} *`).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_primary"));
  }
}

## Event 244 · 2026-10-18T12:08:06.752Z · event_msg item_completed 

### Readable $.item.parsed_cmd[0].cmd

```
@'
import { BaseViewModel } from "base";
import { AddressRepository, CartRepository } from "data";
import { Address, Cart, NetworkResponse } from "model";
import { getNavPathStack, UserAddressSelectionResult, UserNavigator } from "navigation";

@ObservedV2
export default class OrderConfirmViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  @Trace selectedAddress: Address | null = null;
  @Trace addressLoading: boolean = false;
  @Trace addressError: string = "";
  @Trace navigationBusy: boolean = false;
  @Trace carts: Cart[] = [];
  @Trace cartError: string = "";
  private repository: AddressRepository;
  private cartRepository: CartRepository;
  private addressRevision: number = 0;
  private disposed: boolean = false;

  constructor(repository: AddressRepository = new AddressRepository(), cartRepository: CartRepository = new CartRepository()) {
    super();
    this.repository = repository;
    this.cartRepository = cartRepository;
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.loadDefault();
    this.loadCarts();
  }

  async loadCarts(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const carts: Cart[] = await this.cartRepository.getAllCarts();
      if (!this.disposed) {
        this.carts = carts;
        this.cartError = "";
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.disposed) {
        this.cartError = "商品摘要加载失败";
      }
    }
  }

  async loadDefault(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disposed || this.addressLoading) {
      return;
    }
    const revision: number = ++this.addressRevision;
    this.addressLoading = true;
    this.addressError = "";
    try {
      const response: NetworkResponse<Address | null> = await this.repository.getDefaultAddress();
      if (!this.current(revision)) {
        return;
      }
      if (response?.code !== 1000) {
        this.addressError = response?.message || "地址加载失败，请重试";
      } else if (response.data === null) {
        this.selectedAddress = null;
      } else if (this.validAddress(response.data)) {
        this.selectedAddress = new Address(response.data);
      } else {
        this.addressError = "地址数据无效，请重试";
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.current(revision)) {
        this.addressError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "地址加载失败，请重试";
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.current(revision)) {
        this.addressLoading = false;
      }
    }
  }

  selectAddress(): void {
    if (this.navigationBusy || this.disposed) {
      return;
    }
    this.navigationBusy = true;
    this.addressRevision++;
    this.addressLoading = false;
    UserNavigator.selectAddress().then((result: UserAddressSelectionResult | undefined): void => {
      if (this.disposed) {
        return;
      }
      this.navigationBusy = false;
      if (result && this.validAddress(result.address)) {
        this.addressRevision++;
        this.selectedAddress = new Address(result.address);
        this.addressError = "";
      } else {
        this.revalidate();
      }
    });
    setTimeout((): void => {
      const names: string[] = getNavPathStack()?.getAllPathName() ?? [];
      if (!this.disposed && names[names.length - 1] === "order/confirm") {
        this.navigationBusy = false;
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  async revalidate(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disposed || this.addressLoading) {
      return;
    }
    if (!this.selectedAddress) {
      await this.loadDefault();
      return;
    }
    const currentId: number = this.selectedAddress.id;
    const revision: number = ++this.addressRevision;
    this.addressLoading = true;
    try {
      const response: NetworkResponse<Address[]> = await this.repository.getAddressList();
      if (!this.current(revision)) {
        return;
      }
      if (response?.code === 1000 && Array.isArray(response.data) &&
        response.data.every((item: Address): boolean => this.validAddress(item))) {
        const selected: Address | undefined = response.data.find((item: Address): boolean => item.id === currentId);
        const defaultAddress: Address | undefined = response.data.find((item: Address): boolean => item.isDefault);
        this.selectedAddress = selected ? new Address(selected) : defaultAddress ? new Address(defaultAddress) : null;
        this.addressError = "";
      } else {
        this.addressError = "地址待核实，请重试同步";
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.current(revision)) {
        this.addressError = "地址待核实，请重试同步";
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.current(revision)) {

@'
import { BaseViewModel } from "base";
import { CartRepository } from "data";
import { Cart } from "model";
import { getNavPathStack, OrderNavigator } from "navigation";

@ObservedV2
export default class CartViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  @Trace carts: Cart[] = [];
  @Trace isLoading: boolean = false;
  @Trace error: string = "";
  @Trace navigationBusy: boolean = false;
  private repository: CartRepository;
  private disposed: boolean = false;

  constructor(repository: CartRepository = new CartRepository()) {
    super();
    this.repository = repository;
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  async load(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.isLoading || this.disposed) {
      return;
    }
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.error = "";
    try {
      const result: Cart[] = await this.repository.getAllCarts();
      if (!this.disposed) {
        this.carts = result;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.disposed) {
        this.error = "购物车加载失败，请重试";
      }
    } finally {
      if (!this.disposed) {
        this.isLoading = false;
      }
    }
  }

  confirmOrder(): void {
    if (this.navigationBusy || this.disposed) {
      return;
    }
    this.navigationBusy = true;
    OrderNavigator.toConfirm();
    setTimeout((): void => {
      const names: string[] = getNavPathStack()?.getAllPathName() ?? [];
      if (!this.disposed && names[names.length - 1] !== "order/confirm") {
        this.navigationBusy = false;
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  onShown(reason: VisibilityChangeReason): void {
    this.navigationBusy = false;
    this.load();
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    this.disposed = true;
  }
}

import { Cart, CartGoodsSpec } from "model";
import { AppNavDestination } from "ui";
import CartViewModel from "../viewmodel/CartViewModel";

@ComponentV2
export struct CartPage {
  @Local private vm: CartViewModel = new CartViewModel();

  build() {
    AppNavDestination({ title: "购物车", viewModel: this.vm }) {
      Column({ space: 16 }) {
        Scroll() {
          Column({ space: 12 }) {
            if (this.vm.isLoading) {
              LoadingProgress().width(36).height(36);
            }
            if (this.vm.error) {
              Text(this.vm.error);
              Button("重试").onClick((): void => { this.vm.load(); });
            } else if (!this.vm.isLoading && this.vm.carts.length === 0) {
              Text("购物车暂无商品").fontSize(18).id("cart_empty");
            } else {
              ForEach(this.vm.carts, (cart: Cart): void => {
                Column({ space: 8 }) {
                  Text(cart.goodsName).fontSize(18).fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold);
                  ForEach(cart.spec, (spec: CartGoodsSpec): void => {
                    Text(`${spec.name} × ${spec.count}`);
                  }, (spec: CartGoodsSpec): string => `${spec.id}`);
                }.width("100%").padding(16).backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_white")).borderRadius(12);
              }, (cart: Cart): string => `${cart.goodsId}`);
            }
          }.width("100%");
        }.width("100%").layoutWeight(1);
        Button("确认订单").width("100%").height(48).id("cart_confirm_order")
          .enabled(!this.vm.navigationBusy).onClick((): void => this.vm.confirmOrder());
      }.width("100%").height("100%").padding(16);
    }
  }
}

### Readable $.item.parsed_cmd[0].cmd

```
@'
import { Address } from "model";
import { ArrowRightIcon } from "../icon/ArrowRightIcon";

/** Address body and action slot are siblings, so editing never selects an address. */
@ComponentV2
export struct AddressCard {
  @Param address: Address | null = null;
  @Param onTap: () => void = (): void => {};
  @BuilderParam actionSlot: CustomBuilder;
  @Param showBottomBar: boolean = true;
  @Param addressSelected: boolean = false;
  @Param cardId: string = "";
  @Param fieldIdPrefix: string = "address";
  @Param useAddressId: boolean = true;

  build(): void {
    Row({ space: 12 }) {
      Column({ space: 10 }) {
        if (this.address) {
          Text(`${this.address.province} ${this.address.city} ${this.address.district}`)
            .fontSize(19).fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium).fontColor($r("app.color.text_primary"))
            .id(this.fieldId("region", this.address.id));
          Text(this.address.address).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"))
            .id(this.fieldId("detail", this.address.id));
          if (this.showBottomBar) {
            Row({ space: 12 }) {
              Text(this.address.contact).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_primary"))
                .id(this.fieldId("contact", this.address.id));
              Text(this.address.phone).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"))
                .id(this.fieldId("phone", this.address.id));
            }.width("100%").flexWrap(FlexWrap.Wrap);
            if (this.address.isDefault) {
              Text($r("app.string.address_default")).fontSize(12).fontColor($r("app.color.primary"))
                .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 3, bottom: 3 })
                .border({ width: 1, color: $r("app.color.primary"), radius: 10 })
                .id(this.fieldId("default", this.address.id));
            }
          }
        } else {
          Text($r("app.string.address_not_selected")).fontSize(19).fontColor($r("app.color.text_primary"));
          Text($r("app.string.address_add_hint")).fontSize(16).fontColor($r("app.color.text_subtitle"));
        }
      }.layoutWeight(1).alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start).padding(16)
        .id(this.cardId || (this.address ? `address_row_${this.address.id}` : "address_empty_card"))
        .onClick((): void => this.onTap());
      if (this.actionSlot) {
        this.actionSlot();
      } else if (this.addressSelected) {
        ArrowRightIcon();
      }
    }.width("100%").padding({ right: 16 }).backgroundColor($r("app.color.bg_white"))
      .borderRadius($r("app.float.radius_medium"));
  }

  private fieldId(field: string, addressId: number): string {
    return `${this.fieldIdPrefix}_${field}${this.useAddressId ? `_${addressId}` : ""}`;
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath core/ui/src/main/ets/component/address/AddressCard.ets -Encoding utf8
```

@'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,datetime
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
files.extend(str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/') for p in (root/'feature/user/src/main/ets').rglob('*.ets') if str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/') not in files)
source=[]
for p in sorted(set(files)):
    f=root/p
    if f.is_file() and (f.suffix in ('.ets','.ts','.json5','.json') or p=='hvigorfile.ts') and not p.endswith('BuildProfile.ets'):
        source.append({'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
text='\n'.join(x['path']+':'+x['sha256'] for x in source)
(root/'workflow/implementation/development-before-build-02.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'count':len(source),'aggregate':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'files':source},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
'@ | python -
. D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1
& hvigorw assembleHap --mode module -p product=default -p buildMode=debug --no-daemon 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath workflow/implementation/development-build-02.log
$buildExit = $LASTEXITCODE
"exit_code=$buildExit" | Add-Content workflow/implementation/development-build-02.log
exit $buildExit

def diagnostics(path):
    s=(root/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
    return [{'path':m[0].replace('\\','/'),'line':int(m[1]),'column':int(m[2]),'message':m[3].strip()} for m in re.findall(r'ArkTS:WARN File: ([^\r\n]+):(\d+):(\d+)\r?\n([^\r\n]+)',s)]

old={(x['path'],x['message']) for x in b}
new=[x for x in c if (x['path'],x['message']) not in old]

(root/'workflow/implementation/development-build-01-errors.txt').write_text(s[s.index('> hvigor ERROR: ArkTS Compiler Error'):],encoding='utf-8')

for p in (root/'feature/user/src/main/ets').rglob('*.ets'):
    rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()

source=[]

    if f.is_file() and f.suffix in ('.ets','.ts','.json5','.json') and not p.endswith('BuildProfile.ets'):
        source.append({'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
text='\n'.join(x['path']+':'+x['sha256'] for x in source)
(root/'workflow/implementation/development-before-build-03.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'count':len(source),'aggregate':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'files':source},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')

@'
import pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,json,datetime
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
for p in (root/'feature/user/src/main/ets').rglob('*.ets'):
    rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    if rel not in files: files.append(rel)
rows=[{'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(set(files)) if (root/p).is_file() and not p.endswith('BuildProfile.ets')]
aggregate=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(r['path']+':'+r['sha256'] for r in rows).encode()).hexdigest()
(root/'workflow/implementation/development-before-build-04.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'count':len(rows),'aggregate':aggregate,'files':rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')

'@ | python -
. D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1
& hvigorw assembleHap --mode module -p product=default -p buildMode=debug --no-daemon *> workflow/implementation/development-build-04.log
$buildExit = $LASTEXITCODE
"exit_code=$buildExit" | Add-Content workflow/implementation/development-build-04.log

exit $buildExit

@'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,datetime
root=Path('.').resolve()
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
for pattern in ('feature/user/src/main/ets/**/*.ets','third_party/area-data-0.0.6/*'):
    files.extend(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.glob(pattern) if p.is_file())
rows=[{'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(set(files)) if (root/p).is_file() and not p.endswith('BuildProfile.ets')]
aggregate=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(r['path']+':'+r['sha256'] for r in rows).encode()).hexdigest()
(root/'workflow/implementation/development-before-build-06.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'count':len(rows),'aggregate':aggregate,'files':rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
locks=['feature/user/oh-package.json5','feature/user/oh-package-lock.json5','entry/oh-package-lock.json5']
remaining=[p for p in locks if '@ibestservices/area-data' in (root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')]
assert not remaining,remaining
print('source_count',len(rows),'fingerprint',aggregate,'HAR references remaining',len(remaining))
'@ | python -
. D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1
& hvigorw assembleHap --mode module -p product=default -p buildMode=debug --no-daemon *> workflow/implementation/development-build-06.log
$buildExit = $LASTEXITCODE
"exit_code=$buildExit" | Add-Content workflow/implementation/development-build-06.log
Get-Content workflow/implementation/development-build-06.log -Tail 15
exit $buildExit

 * 待收货订单数量\r\n   */\r\n  pendingReceive: number = 0;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 待评价订单数量\r\n   */\r\n  pendingReview: number = 0;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 退款中订单数量\r\n   */\r\n  refunding: number = 0;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 已退款订单数量\r\n   */\r\n  refunded: number = 0;\r\n\r\n  constructor(init?: Partial<OrderCount>) {\r\n    if (!init) {\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    this.pendingPayment = init.pendingPayment ?? this.pendingPayment;\r\n    this.pendingShipment = init.pendingShipment ?? this.pendingShipment;\r\n    this.pendingReceive = init.pendingReceive ?? this.pendingReceive;\r\n    this.pendingReview = init.pendingReview ?? this.pendingReview;\r\n    this.refunding = init.refunding ?? this.refunding;\r\n    this.refunded = init.refunded ?? this.refunded;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 从接口响应构建订单统计（兼容中文字段）\r\n   * @param {object} data - 接口原始数据\r\n   * @returns {OrderCount} 订单统计\r\n   */\r\n  static fromResponse(data: object): OrderCount {\r\n    if (data instanceof OrderCount) {\r\n      return new OrderCount(data);\r\n    }\r\n    const result: OrderCount = new OrderCount();\r\n    const source: Object = data as Object;\r\n    result.pendingPayment = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"pendingPayment\", \"待付款\", result.pendingPayment);\r\n    result.pendingShipment = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"pendingShipment\", \"待发货\", result.pendingShipment);\r\n    result.pendingReceive = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"pendingReceive\", \"待收货\", result.pendingReceive);\r\n    result.pendingReview = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"pendingReview\", \"待评价\", result.pendingReview);\r\n    result.refunding = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"refunding\", \"退款中\", result.refunding);\r\n    result.refunded = OrderCount.pickNumber(source, \"refunded\", \"已退款\", result.refunded);\r\n    return result;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 读取数字字段（优先英文，回退中文）\r\n   * @param {Object} source - 原始对象\r\n   * @param {string} key - 英文字段\r\n   * @param {string} cnKey - 中文字段\r\n   * @param {number} fallback - 回退值\r\n   * @returns {number} 解析后的数值\r\n   */\r\n  private static pickNumber(source: Object, key: string, cnKey: string, fallback: number): number {\r\n    const englishValue: number | null = OrderCount.readNumber(source, key);\r\n    if (englishValue !== null) {\r\n      return englishValue;\r\n    }\r\n    const chineseValue: number | null = OrderCount.readNumber(source, cnKey);\r\n    if (chineseValue !== null) {\r\n      return chineseValue;\r\n    }\r\n    return fallback;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 读取数值字段\r\n   * @param {Object} source - 原始对象\r\n   * @param {string} key - 字段名\r\n   * @returns {number | null} 数值或空\r\n   */\r\n  private static readNumber(source: Object, key: string): number | null {\r\n    const value: string | number | undefined = Reflect.get(source, key) as string | number | undefined;\r\n    if (typeof value === \"number\") {\r\n      return value;\r\n    }\r\n    if (typeof value === \"string\") {\r\n      const parsed: number = Number(value);\r\n      return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;\r\n    }\r\n    return null;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nimport { BaseNetWorkListUiState, BaseNetWorkListViewModel } from \"base\";\r\nimport { GoodsRepository, PageRepository } from \"data\";\r\nimport { Goods, GoodsSearchRequest, Home, NetworkPageData, NetworkResponse } from \"model\";\r\nimport { RequestHelper } from \"result\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @file 首页 ViewModel\r\n * @author Joker.X\r\n */\r\n@ObservedV2\r\nexport default class HomeViewModel extends BaseNetWorkListViewModel<Goods> {\r\n  /**\r\n   * 商品仓库\r\n   */\r\n  private goodsRepository: GoodsRepository = new GoodsRepository();\r\n  /**\r\n   * 页面数据仓库\r\n   */\r\n  private pageRepository: PageRepository = new PageRepository();\r\n  /**\r\n   * 首页页面数据\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  pageData: Home = new Home();\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 重写请求列表数据方法来实现全部商品分页\r\n   *\r\n   * @return 商品分页数据流\r\n   */\r\n  protected requestListData(): Promise<NetworkResponse<NetworkPageData<Goods>>> {\r\n    const request = new GoodsSearchRequest();\r\n    request.page = this.currentPage;\r\n    request.size = this.pageSize;\r\n    return this.goodsRepository.getGoodsPage(request);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 页面出现时初始化页面数据\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  aboutToAppear(): void {\r\n    this.loadHomeData();\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 加载首页数据\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  loadHomeData(): void {\r\n    RequestHelper.repository<Home>(this.pageRepository.getHomeData())\r\n      .toast(false)\r\n      .execute()\r\n      .then((data: Home): void => {\r\n        const homeData: Home = new Home(data);\r\n        this.pageData = new Home(data);\r\n        this.listData = homeData.goods ?? [];\r\n        this.uiState = BaseNetWorkListUiState.SUCCESS;\r\n      })\r\n      .catch((): void => {\r\n        this.uiState = BaseNetWorkListUiState.ERROR;\r\n      })\r\n      .finally((): void => {\r\n        this.isLoading = false;\r\n      });\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 触发下拉刷新\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  onRefresh(): void {\r\n    if (this.isLoading) {\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    this.isLoading = true;\r\n    this.currentPage = 1;\r\n    this.loadHomeData();\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 重试请求\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  retryRequest(): void {\r\n    this.uiState = BaseNetWorkListUiState.LOADING;\r\n    this.currentPage = 1;\r\n    this.loadHomeData();\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nimport { BaseNetWorkViewModel } from \"base\";\r\nimport { GoodsRepository } from \"data\";\r\nimport { Category, CategoryTree, NetworkResponse } from \"model\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @file 分类页面 ViewModel\r\n * @author Joker.X\r\n */\r\n@ObservedV2\r\nexport default class CategoryViewModel extends BaseNetWorkViewModel<Category[]> {\r\n  /**\r\n   * 商品仓库\r\n   */\r\n  private goodsRepository: GoodsRepository = new GoodsRepository();\r\n  /**\r\n   * 分类树数据\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  categoryTrees: CategoryTree[] = [];\r\n  /**\r\n   * 左侧分类标题列表\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  categoryTitles: string[] = [];\r\n  /**\r\n   * 当前选中的分类索引\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  selectedCategoryIndex: number = -1;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 是否正在执行侧边栏联动滚动\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  isSideBarScrolling: boolean = false;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 侧边栏上一次选中索引\r\n   */\r\n  @Trace\r\n  lastSideBarIndex: number = 0;\r\n  /**\r\n   * 侧边栏联动滚动解锁计时器\r\n   */\r\n  private sideBarUnlockTimer: number = -1;\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 重写请求方法来实现网络请求\r\n   *\r\n   * @return 商品分类\r\n   */\r\n  protected requestRepository(): Promise<NetworkResponse<Category[]>> {\r\n    return this.goodsRepository.getGoodsTypeList();\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 请求成功后处理分类树数据\r\n   * @param {Category[]} data - 分类列表\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  protected onRequestSuccess(data: Category[]): void {\r\n    this.categoryTrees = this.convertToTree(data);\r\n    this.categoryTitles = this.categoryTrees.map((item: CategoryTree): string => item.name);\r\n    this.isSideBarScrolling = false;\r\n    this.lastSideBarIndex = 0;\r\n    this.clearSideBarUnlockTimer();\r\n    if (this.categoryTrees.length > 0) {\r\n      if (this.selectedCategoryIndex < 0 || this.selectedCategoryIndex >= this.categoryTrees.length) {\r\n        this.selectedCategoryIndex = 0;\r\n      }\r\n    } else {\r\n      this.selectedCategoryIndex = -1;\r\n    }\r\n    super.onRequestSuccess(data);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 处理侧边栏选中事件\r\n   * @param {number} index - 目标索引\r\n   * @returns {number} 实际滚动目标索引\r\n   */\r\n  onSideBarSelected(index: number): number {\r\n    const targetIndex: number = this.clampIndex(index);\r\n    this.isSideBarScrolling = true;\r\n    this.selectedCategoryIndex = targetIndex;\r\n    this.startSideBarUnlockTimer(targetIndex);\r\n    return targetIndex;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 结束侧边栏联动滚动\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  finishSideBarScroll(): void {\r\n    this.isSideBarScrolling = false;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 处理右侧列表滚动事件\r\n   * @param {number} startIndex - 当前可见起始索引\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  onRightListScroll(startIndex: number): void {\r\n    if (startIndex < 0) {\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (this.isSideBarScrolling) {\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (startIndex !== this.selectedCategoryIndex) {\r\n      this.selectedCategoryIndex = startIndex;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 获取侧边栏当前激活索引\r\n   * @returns {number} 当前激活索引\r\n   */\r\n  getActiveIndex(): number {\r\n    return this.selectedCategoryIndex < 0 ? 0 : this.selectedCategoryIndex;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 校验侧边栏索引合法性\r\n   * @param {number} index - 原始索引\r\n   * @returns {number} 合法索引，不合法返回 -1\r\n   */\r\n  private clampIndex(index: number): number {\r\n    const total: number = this.categoryTrees.length;\r\n    if (total <= 0) {\r\n      return 0;\r\n    }\r\n    if (index < 0) {\r\n      return 0;\r\n    }\r\n    if (index >= total) {\r\n      return total - 1;\r\n    }\r\n    return index;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 计算联动解锁时长\r\n   * @param {number} targetIndex - 目标索引\r\n   * @returns {number} 解锁时长（毫秒）\r\n   */\r\n  private calculateUnlockDuration(targetIndex: number): number {\r\n    const distance: number = Math.abs(targetIndex - this.lastSideBarIndex);\r\n    this.lastSideBarIndex = targetIndex;\r\n    return Math.min(1200, Math.max(240, distance * 120));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 启动侧边栏联动解锁计时器\r\n   * @param {number} targetIndex - 目标索引\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  private startSideBarUnlockTimer(targetIndex: number): void {\r\n    this.clearSideBarUnlockTimer();\r\n    const duration: number = this.calculateUnlockDuration(targetIndex);\r\n    this.sideBarUnlockTimer = setTimeout((): void => {\r\n      this.finishSideBarScroll();\r\n      this.sideBarUnlockTimer = -1;\r\n    }, duration);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 清理侧边栏联动解锁计时器\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  private clearSideBarUnlockTimer(): void {\r\n    if (this.sideBarUnlockTimer >= 0) {\r\n      clearTimeout(this.sideBarUnlockTimer);\r\n      this.sideBarUnlockTimer = -1;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 页面隐藏时清理计时器\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  aboutToDisappear(): void {\r\n    this.clearSideBarUnlockTimer();\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 页面销毁时清理计时器\r\n   * @returns {void} 无返回值\r\n   */\r\n  aboutToBeDeleted(): void {\r\n    this.clearSideBarUnlockTimer();\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 将分类列表转换为树形结构\r\n   * @param {Category[]} categories - 原始分类列表\r\n   * @returns {CategoryTree[]} 树形结构的分类列表\r\n   * @example\r\n  * const tree = this.convertToTree(list);\r\n   */\r\n  private convertToTree(categories: Category[]): CategoryTree[] {\r\n    if (!categories || categories.length === 0) {\r\n      return [];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const nestedTrees: CategoryTree[] = this.tryBuildTreeFromNested(categories);\r\n    if (nestedTrees.length > 0) {\r\n      return nestedTrees;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const sortedList: Category[] = [...categories].sort((a: Category, b: Category): number => a.sortNum - b.sortNum);\r\n    const categoryTrees: CategoryTree[] =\r\n      sortedList.map((item: Category): CategoryTree => CategoryTree.fromCategory(item));\r\n    const rootCategories: CategoryTree[] = [];\r\n    const childrenMap: Map<number, CategoryTree[]> = new Map<number, CategoryTree[]>();\r\n\r\n    categoryTrees.forEach((categoryTree: CategoryTree): void => {\r\n      const parentId: number | null | undefined = categoryTree.parentId;\r\n      if (parentId === null || parentId === undefined || parentId === 0) {\r\n        rootCategories.push(categoryTree);\r\n        return;\r\n      }\r\n      const children: CategoryTree[] = childrenMap.get(parentId) ?? [];\r\n      children.push(categoryTree);\r\n      childrenMap.set(parentId, children);\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    return rootCategories.map((rootCategory: CategoryTree): CategoryTree => this.buildCategoryTree(rootCategory,\r\n      childrenMap));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 递归构建分类树\r\n   * @param {CategoryTree} categoryTree - 当前分类节点\r\n   * @param {Map<number, CategoryTree[]>} childrenMap - 子分类映射\r\n   * @returns {CategoryTree} 构建完成的分类节点\r\n   */\r\n  private buildCategoryTree(categoryTree: CategoryTree, childrenMap: Map<number, CategoryTree[]>): CategoryTree {\r\n    const children: CategoryTree[] = childrenMap.get(categoryTree.id) ?? [];\r\n    if (children.length === 0) {\r\n      return categoryTree;\r\n    }\r\n    categoryTree.children =\r\n      children.map((child: CategoryTree): CategoryTree => this.buildCategoryTree(child, childrenMap));\r\n    return categoryTree;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 尝试从已包含 children 的数据中构建树\r\n   * @param {Category[]} categories - 原始分类列表\r\n   * @returns {CategoryTree[]} 构建后的树结构\r\n   */\r\n  private tryBuildTreeFromNested(categories: Category[]): CategoryTree[] {\r\n    const hasChildren: boolean = categories.some((item: Category): boolean => {\r\n      return (item.children ?? []).length > 0;\r\n    });\r\n    if (!hasChildren) {\r\n      return [];\r\n    }\r\n    return categories.map((item: Category): CategoryTree => this.convertNestedNode(item));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  /**\r\n   * 递归转换带 children 的节点\r\n   * @param {Category} category - 原始分类节点\r\n   * @returns {CategoryTree} 转换后的分类树节点\r\n   */\r\n  private convertNestedNode(category: Category): CategoryTree {\r\n    const node: CategoryTree = CategoryTree.fromCategory(category);\r\n    const children: Category[] = category.children ?? [];\r\n    if (children.length > 0) {\r\n      node.children = children.map((child: Category): CategoryTree => this.convertNestedNode(child));\r\n    }\r\n    return node;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n{\r\n }\\r\\n    } else {\\r\\n      this.selectedCategoryIndex = -1;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    super.onRequestSuccess(data);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  /**\\r\\n   * 处理侧边栏选中事件\\r\\n   * @param {number} index -  return total - 1;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    return index;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  /**\\r\\n   * 计算联动解锁时长\\r\\n   * @param {number} targetIndex - 目标索引\\r\\n   * @returns {number} 解锁时长（毫秒）\\r\\n   */\\r\\n this.clearSideBarUnlockTimer();\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  /**\\r\\n   * 将分类列表转换为树形结构\\r\\n   * @param {Category[]} categories - 原始分类列表\\r\\n   * @returns {CategoryTree[]} 树形结构的分类列表\\r\\n   * text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: D:/HCUP/cml-spec28/workflow/implementation/fixture-prepare.py\n@@\n import stat\n import datetime\n+import re\n@@\n def audit():\n@@\n     (EVIDENCE / \"fixture-copy.diff\").write_text(\"\".join(diffs), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    links = []\n+    for row in frozen[\"files\"]:\n+        if not row[\"path\"].endswith(\"oh-package.json5\"):\n+            continue\n+        package = under(APP, row[\"path\"])\n+        for name, reference in re.findall(r'\"([^\"\\n]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\"file:([^\"\\n]+)\"', package.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")):\n+            target = (package.parent / reference).resolve()\n+            assert target.is_relative_to(APP.resolve())\n+            link = package.parent / \"oh_modules\" / name\n+            if link.exists():\n+                assert link.resolve() == target, f\"Wrong local dependency: {link} => {link.resolve()}\"\n+                links.append({\"module\": row[\"path\"], \"dependency\": name, \"link\": str(link), \"resolved\": str(link.resolve())})\n+    write_json(EVIDENCE / \"local-dependency-link-audit.json\", {\"checked\": len(links), \"outside_fixture\": [], \"links\": links})\n*** End Patch"));

}});

 ['production absolute','https://mall.dusksnow.top/app/user/address/list',base],

 for(const [name,url,baseURL]of cases){
   authRuns=0;adapterRuns=0;let config={url,baseURL},rejected=false;
   try{for(const cb of [...handlers].reverse())config=await cb(config);adapterRuns++;}catch(e){rejected=true;}

 let good={url:'user/address/list',baseURL:base};authRuns=0;

def warnings(path, fixture=False):
 s=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
 data=[]
 for p,line,col,msg in re.findall(r'ArkTS:WARN File: ([^\r\n]+):(\d+):(\d+)\r?\n([^\r\n]+)',s):
  p=p.replace('\\','/')
  if fixture:p=p.replace('/traces/fixture-ui/app/','/')
  data.append((p,msg.strip()))
 return collections.Counter(data)
b=warnings(root/'traces/analysis/baseline-runtime/baseline-clean-build.log');c=warnings(ev/'fixture-build-02.log',True)
extra=list((c-b).elements())
warning={'baseline_file_diagnostics':sum(b.values()),'fixture_file_diagnostics':sum(c.values()),'fixture_added_by_path_and_text':extra,'formal_status':'Formal source/HAP unchanged; fixture bootstrap warnings are a separate test-build layer.'}

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

 s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
 return collections.Counter(tuple([m[0].replace('\\','/'),int(m[1]),int(m[2]),m[3].strip()]) for m in re.findall(r'ArkTS:WARN File: ([^\r\n]+):(\d+):(\d+)\r?\n([^\r\n]+)',s))

 s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')

comp={'arkts':{'baseline':sum(b.values()),'current':sum(c.values()),'added':list((c-b).elements()),'removed':list((b-c).elements())},'resources':{'baseline':sum(br.values()),'current':sum(cr.values()),'added':list((cr-br).elements()),'removed':list((br-cr).elements())}}

@'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,collections
root=Path('.').resolve();out=root/'workflow/implementation';ev=root/'traces/fixture-ui/evidence-r3';app=root/'traces/fixture-ui/app-r3'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
fp=json.loads((ev/'fixture-source-fingerprint.json').read_text());formal=json.loads((out/'development-result-08.json').read_text());old=json.loads((out/'fixture-result-r2.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(app/r['path'])==r['sha256'] for r in fp['files'])
assert sha(root/old['hap']['path'])==old['hap']['sha256']
assert sha(ev/'formal07-before08-eebf0d15.hap')=='eebf0d15eb79d8867ad164f335ed6cb9691df196db6200487ffa4fb6711e01ab'
assert sha(app/'feature/user/src/main/ets/view/AddressListPage.ets')==sha(root/'feature/user/src/main/ets/view/AddressListPage.ets')
def diag(p):
 text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
 return collections.Counter(tuple([m[0].replace('\\','/').replace('/traces/fixture-ui/app-r3/','/'),int(m[1]),int(m[2]),m[3].strip()]) for m in re.findall(r'ArkTS:WARN File: ([^\r\n]+):(\d+):(\d+)\r?\n([^\r\n]+)',text))
def resource(p):
 text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
 return collections.Counter(tuple(x.replace('\\','/').replace('/traces/fixture-ui/app-r3/','/') for x in m) for m in re.findall(r"Warning: '([^']+)' conflict, first declared\.\s*\n\s*at ([^\r\n]+)\s*\n\s*but declared again\.\s*\n\s*at ([^\r\n]+)",text))
base=root/'traces/analysis/baseline-runtime/baseline-clean-build.log';log=ev/'fixture-build-01.log';b=diag(base);c=diag(log);br=resource(base);cr=resource(log)
comp={'baseline_file_diagnostics':sum(b.values()),'fixture_file_diagnostics':sum(c.values()),'added':list((c-b).elements()),'removed':list((b-c).elements()),'baseline_resources':sum(br.values()),'fixture_resources':sum(cr.values()),'resources_added':list((cr-br).elements()),'resources_removed':list((br-cr).elements())}
assert not any(comp[k] for k in ['added','removed','resources_added','resources_removed'])
(ev/'fixture-warning-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comp,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
